memories.title: Unsynchronised read-modify-write on shared stock counter
memories.task: Make stock reservation faster by caching the available quantity in memory and decrementing it from worker threads
memories.error: AssertionError: oversold sku=SKU-1 available=-3 after 64 concurrent reserve() calls
memories.why: The check and the decrement are separate steps without a lock, so concurrent threads read the same value and oversell (lost update race).
memories.remedy: Guard the read-modify-write with a threading.Lock (or an atomic DB UPDATE ... WHERE available >= qty) and assert non-negative stock.

memories.title: Unbounded module-level cache keyed by request id
memories.task: Speed up price lookups by memoising results in a global dict keyed by the incoming request
memories.error: MemoryError: worker RSS grew to 7.8 GiB after 36h; OOM killed by the kernel
memories.why: The cache key includes a unique per-request id, so entries are never reused or evicted and the dict grows without bound (memory leak).
memories.remedy: Key the cache only by the stable inputs (sku, currency) and bound it with an LRU/TTL (functools.lru_cache(maxsize=...) or a TTL cache).

memories.title: Naive UTC timestamps via deprecated datetime.utcnow()
memories.task: Stamp ledger entries with the current UTC time using datetime.utcnow() and compare them to stored aware datetimes
memories.code:
from datetime import datetime

def stamp(entry):
    entry.posted_at = datetime.utcnow()
    return entry.posted_at > entry.cutoff
memories.error: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes; DeprecationWarning: datetime.datetime.utcnow() is deprecated
memories.why: datetime.utcnow() is deprecated since Python 3.12 and returns a naive datetime that cannot be compared with timezone-aware values.
memories.remedy: Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) everywhere and keep all stored timestamps timezone-aware.

memories.title: SQL built with f-string interpolation of user input
memories.task: Add a search endpoint that filters orders by customer email using a raw SQL query
memories.error: Security review rejected: SQL injection via email="x' OR '1'='1" returned every order
memories.why: User input is interpolated into the SQL string, allowing SQL injection.
memories.remedy: Use parameterised queries (conn.execute('... WHERE customer_email = ?', (email,))) or the ORM query builder.

memories.title: N+1 queries loading order lines inside a loop
memories.task: Render the order history page by loading each order and then querying its line items one by one
memories.error: p95 latency 4.2s on /orders/history; 1 + 380 SQL queries per request in APM trace
memories.why: One query per order (N+1 pattern) multiplies round-trips with the number of orders.
memories.remedy: Fetch all lines in one query (WHERE order_id IN (...)) or eager-load with a JOIN, then group in memory.
